text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 222 June 20, 1973
EXTENDING UP TO SEPTEMBER 30, 1973, THE DEADLINE FOR THE FILING OF INDIVIDUAL
DECLARATION OF THE TRUE VALUE OF REAL PROPERTY
WHEREAS, the deadline fixed under Presidential Decree No. 76 dated December 6, 1972, for the filing of
individual declarations on the true value of real property is June 30, 1973; and
WHEREAS, there has been widespread clamor for the extension of the deadline as fixed in said decree for the
reason, among others, that many assessors have not completed the evaluation of properties in their
jurisdiction;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, do hereby extend the deadline for the filing of individual declaration of the true value of real property
fixed under Presidential Decree No. 76 from June 30, 1973, to September 30, 1973.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
